references.note: Official pages emphasize convenience/performance benefits; exact current price presentation is not treated as a stable cross-region benchmark here.
Subscriptions are app-specific and renew every 30 days; not a direct apples-to-apples platform price benchmark.

modaryxImplications.statement: 4.99 EUR/month is a defensible research stimulus because an adjacent platform currently charges 4.99 USD/month, but currency, tax, feature set and market differences prevent direct equivalence.
6.99 and 8.99 EUR/month require substantially stronger recurring user value than ad removal or download convenience alone.
MODARYX should not copy artificial delays or speed restrictions into the free tier merely to manufacture Premium value.
Safety, accessibility, rights/provenance visibility and essential recovery remain baseline product quality, not Premium upsells.
Current market references do not replace willingness-to-pay testing, activation/retention, cost per MAU, refunds/chargebacks, VAT/tax and legal readiness.
